summary:
I now have enough verified data. Here are the findings ranked by impact:

---

**Findings (all verified by reading the code)**

**1. `KafkaNetworkChannel.java:201–218` — 9-branch instanceof+cast chain**
`raft/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/raft/KafkaNetworkChannel.java`, line 201
Each `instanceof VoteRequestData` is immediately followed by `(VoteRequestData) requestData` etc., nine times.
Fix: Use Java 16+ pattern matching — `if (requestData instanceof VoteRequestData vrd) return new VoteRequest.Builder(vrd);` — eliminating all 9 redundant casts.

**2. `RecordsIterator.java:164–167` — instanceof+cast for MemoryRecords/FileRecords**
`raft/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/raft/internals/RecordsIterator.java`, line 164
`if (records instanceof MemoryRecords) { memoryRecords = (MemoryRecords) records; } else if (records instanceof FileRecords) { memoryRecords = createMemoryRecords((FileRecords) records); }` — both branches cast immediately.
Fix: `if (records instanceof MemoryRecords mr) { ... = mr; } else if (records instanceof FileRecords fr) { ... = createMemoryRecords(fr); }`.

**3. `RecordsIterator.java:189,195` — negated guard then unconditional cast**
`raft/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/raft/internals/RecordsIterator.java`, line 189
After `if (!(nextBatch instanceof DefaultRecordBatch)) throw ...`, the code calls `readBatch((DefaultRecordBatch) nextBatch)` — redundant cast.
Fix: Replace the negated guard + subsequent cast with `if (nextBatch instanceof DefaultRecordBatch drb) { return Optional.of(readBatch(drb)); } else { throw ...; }`.

**4. `RemotePartitionMetadataEventHandler.java:28–33` — 3-way instanceof+cast dispatch**
`storage/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/server/log/remote/metadata/storage/RemotePartitionMetadataEventHandler.java`, line 28
Three `instanceof X` checks each followed by a `(X) remoteLogMetadata` cast passed to a method.
Fix: Pattern matching: `if (remoteLogMetadata instanceof RemoteLogSegmentMetadata m)` etc., removing the three casts.

**5. `KafkaConfigSchema.java:245,249` — instanceof String/Password + cast**
`metadata/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/metadata/KafkaConfigSchema.java`, line 245
`if (value instanceof String) { stringValue = (String) value; } else if (value instanceof Password) { stringValue = ((Password) value).value(); }`.
Fix: `if (value instanceof String s) { stringValue = s; } else if (value instanceof Password p) { stringValue = p.value(); }`.

**6. `QuorumState.java:763,784,799` — three identical `instanceof`+cast wrapper methods**
`raft/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/raft/QuorumState.java`, lines 763, 784, 799
`maybeUnattachedState`, `maybeLeaderState` (non-generic only), and `maybeProspectiveState` all follow the pattern `if (fixedState instanceof X) return Optional.of((X) fixedState)`.
Fix: Pattern matching eliminates the cast; `maybeLeaderState` has an unchecked generic, so only the two non-generic variants (`UnattachedState`, `ProspectiveState`) are safe to change without `@SuppressWarnings`.

**7. `KafkaRaftClient.java:2176–2179` — MemoryRecords/UnalignedMemoryRecords instanceof+cast**
`raft/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/raft/KafkaRaftClient.java`, line 2176
`if (... instanceof MemoryRecords) { records = new UnalignedMemoryRecords(((MemoryRecords) ...).buffer()); }` — double access + cast.
Fix: `if (... instanceof MemoryRecords mr) { records = new UnalignedMemoryRecords(mr.buffer()); }` and `else if (... instanceof UnalignedMemoryRecords umr) { records = umr; }`.

**8. `LogSegment.java:638–643` and `790–796` — two nearly-identical rethrow patterns**
`storage/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/storage/internals/log/LogSegment.java`, lines 638 and 790
Two separate catch blocks rethrow by `instanceof IOException`, `instanceof RuntimeException`, `instanceof Error` with casts; the bodies are nearly identical (one has 2 branches, one has 3).
Fix: Extract a private static `rethrow(Throwable t)` helper that uses pattern matching for the casts, called from both catch blocks.

**9. `RemoteLogMetadataSerde.java:71–78` — 4-way instanceof dispatch without casts (no pattern gain)**
`storage/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/server/log/remote/metadata/storage/serialization/RemoteLogMetadataSerde.java`, line 71
These branches pass the whole `apiMessageAndVersion` (not a cast of `message`) to transform methods, so no cast is present in the branch — pattern matching doesn't help here. (Non-finding; noted for completeness.)

**10. `PartitionRegistration.java:169,176` — two `checkDirectories` overloads with similar but subtly different validation**
`metadata/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/metadata/PartitionRegistration.java`, lines 169 and 176
Both check `!directories.isEmpty() && replicas.size() != directories.size()` but the `PartitionChangeRecord` variant adds a null check on `replicas`. The duplication is real but the difference is subtle enough that merging requires care; the fix is a single private helper taking `(List<?> replicas, List<?> directories)` with null-safe guards.

**11. `OptionalStringComparator.java:38` — `a.get().compareTo(b.get())` after emptiness checks**
`metadata/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/metadata/OptionalStringComparator.java`, line 38
Both `.get()` calls come after the early-return guards for empty optionals — safe, but replace with `orElseThrow()` to make the invariant explicit.

**12. `AclControlManager.java:117` and `ClusterMetadataAuthorizer.java:119,159` — triplicated ternary cast**
Three files in `metadata` duplicate this pattern: `ApiException e = (t instanceof ApiException) ? (ApiException) t : new UnknownServerException(...)`.
Fix: Extract a package-private helper `ApiExceptions.toApiException(Throwable t, String fallbackMsg)` shared across the three sites.
